messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or live data feeds, so I can’t give you the exact current time in New York City right now. However, if you’re looking for the local time relative to your own timezone, you can check the clock on your device or look up “current time in New York” online.
message.reasoning: User asks for current time in NYC. We can use the function to get weather forecast; but we need time. There's no function for time. We could approximate using weather function with hour=0? But that's not correct. We should respond that we cannot provide real-time data.
